escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.exploit_scenario: Backend processes untrusted templates via handlebars. Attacker submits crafted template input triggering AST type confusion, achieving arbitrary code execution on the backend server.
escalations.recommendation: Update handlebars to >=4.7.9 immediately: cd Source/Backend && npm update handlebars && npm audit
escalations.escalation_reason: injection — exploitable if backend processes any untrusted template strings

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Code Execution
escalations.exploit_scenario: When Vitest UI server is listening (e.g., in CI with --ui flag), any attacker reachable on the network can read and execute arbitrary files without authentication. CI pipeline compromise could expose secrets or enable supply chain attack.
escalations.recommendation: Update vitest to >=3.2.6: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest && npm audit. Confirm UI server is not exposed in CI/CD with --ui flag.
escalations.escalation_reason: injection / code execution — CI infrastructure audit required

escalations.title: form-data CRLF Injection via Multipart Field Names
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker submits multipart form-data with CRLF sequences in field names or filenames. Unescaped values propagate into HTTP headers, enabling header injection attacks that could poison caches or forge response headers.
escalations.recommendation: Update form-data to >=4.0.6 in all workspaces: cd Source/Backend && npm update form-data; cd Source/Frontend && npm update form-data
escalations.escalation_reason: injection — CRLF in HTTP headers; verify multipart endpoint usage

fixer_backlog.title: Traceability Enforcer Blind to portal/ and platform/ — 86 Requirements Appear Missing
fixer_backlog.exploit_scenario: Agent or CI gate runs the enforcer and sees 76 requirements as missing. It concludes the feature is unimplemented and reverts or re-implements existing code, causing regression.
fixer_backlog.impact: False FAIL on every CI run for portal/ and platform/ features. Any agent checking the gate is misled about project quality.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Add 'portal' and 'platform' to source_dirs in check_traceability(). Create a wrapper script that runs enforcer once per implementation zone.

fixer_backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed: seed.ts Missing — Dependency Feature Cannot Be Demonstrated
fixer_backlog.exploit_scenario: GET /api/bugs/BUG-0010 returns empty blocked_by array instead of 5 items. Acceptance criteria for FR-dependency-seed fails. Dependency feature appears broken in demo.
fixer_backlog.impact: Feature acceptance criterion fails; dependency UI cannot be validated without seed data.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with 9 dependency relationships. Call from index.ts after schema migration with existence check for idempotency.

fixer_backlog.title: UpdateBugInput / UpdateFeatureRequestInput Missing blocked_by Field — Type Safety Gap
fixer_backlog.exploit_scenario: Frontend callers updating blocked_by must use 'as any' casts or rely on duck typing. TypeScript compiler cannot catch incorrect blocked_by payloads. Runtime bugs silently propagate.
fixer_backlog.impact: End-to-end type safety broken for dependency-linking feature. TypeScript provides no protection for blocked_by field mutations.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[]; // Verifies: FR-dependency-api-types to UpdateBugInput (line 59) and UpdateFeatureRequestInput (line 32) in portal/Shared/api.ts.

fixer_backlog.title: FR-070–073 Namespace Collision — Two Features Share Same IDs
fixer_backlog.exploit_scenario: Traceability tool reports FR-070 as covered when only image-upload implementation exists but orchestrator-cycle-dashboard code was deleted (or vice versa). False positive masks missing implementation.
fixer_backlog.impact: Future traceability reports will attribute wrong code to wrong specs. Maintainers cannot reliably use FR IDs for audit or regression tracking.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Rename orchestrator-cycle-dashboard IDs to FR-090+ or FR-OCD-001 namespace. Update all // Verifies: comments in portal/ code and requirements file. Coordinate with requirements-reviewer.

fixer_backlog.title: Route Handlers Bypass Service Layer — Direct Store Imports in 3 Route Files
fixer_backlog.exploit_scenario: Business logic leaks into route handlers. Future change to store interface breaks routes directly with no service-layer buffer. Cross-cutting concerns (auth, validation, logging) cannot be enforced consistently.
fixer_backlog.impact: Architecture rule violation: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers'. Store is the persistence layer; routes must delegate to services. Affects workItems.ts, workflow.ts, intake.ts.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts wrapping all CRUD store calls. Refactor workItems.ts (5 operations), workflow.ts (findById, getAll, updateWorkItem), and intake.ts (createWorkItem) to delegate to the service.

fixer_backlog.title: Vite fs.deny Bypass on Windows Alternate Paths
fixer_backlog.exploit_scenario: On Windows dev machines, attacker uses UNC paths or Windows short names to bypass Vite's fs.deny rules and read files outside the project root — potentially exposing .env files or credentials.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Update vite to >=6.4.3: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite. Test dev server startup and React 18 compatibility.

fixer_backlog.title: ws WebSocket Memory Exhaustion DoS
fixer_backlog.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends tiny WebSocket fragments repeatedly, causing unbounded memory growth in the ws library. Backend or Vite dev server becomes unresponsive and crashes.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Update ws to >=8.21.0 via vitest update: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest (cascades ws update).

fixer_backlog.title: Express DoS via qs Query String Null Pointer Crash
fixer_backlog.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts query string with null/undefined entries in comma-format array with encodeValuesOnly=true. qs.stringify crashes with TypeError, crashing the Express request handler and returning 500.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Update express to >=4.22.2: cd Source/Backend && npm update express && npm audit.
